title.en: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Province of Davao
title.orig: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Province of Davao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2588_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Tigbawan, Lubganon and Boa in the Municipality of Caraga, same province, are converted into barrios of said municipality to be known as the barrios of Tigbawan, Lubganon and Boa, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
